about_the_game:
A set of skins: Beast for the game "Lizards Must Die 2" is an additional content that turns the main characters into fearless Hunters of the Wilds.

Try on the main characters the unique armor worn by the hunters of the Ancient Forests of Hyperborea. Curb your inner beast. The lizards will feel the power of the Rus ancestors, and you can brag to your friends that you have extra money to buy skins for online games and enjoy the updated appearance of your characters.

The set includes skins for the four main characters: Drocheslav, Vseslav, Viktor and Mstislav. A unique armor and weapon shape is added for each character.
